DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with probable right-sided heart failure (cor pulmonale).

The combination of a long smoking history, occupational dust exposure, hyperinflation on X-ray, and exertional dyspnea with expiratory wheezing strongly points to COPD.
